DeckMigration.title: Import from Cockatrice
DeckMigration.guest: Decks are saved to your account on this server. Sign in with a registered account to import decks; replays and custom sets can still be imported into this browser.
DeckMigration.offline: You're not connected to a server, so decks can't be imported right now. Replays and custom sets can still be imported into this browser.

source.intro: Bring over the decks, replays and custom sets from desktop Cockatrice. Choose your Cockatrice folder (or just its decks folder), or drop files and folders here. You'll see what was found before anything is imported.
source.drop: Drop your Cockatrice folder, a decks folder or deck files here
source.whereTitle: Where desktop Cockatrice keeps your files

hint.windows: This folder is hidden. In the folder picker, paste the path into the address bar and press Enter.
hint.macos: Library is hidden in Finder. In the folder picker, press Cmd+Shift+G and paste the path.
hint.linux: Folders starting with a dot are hidden. In the folder picker, press Ctrl+L and paste the path, or Ctrl+H to show hidden folders.

source.what: Inside it, decks/ holds your decks (with their subfolders), replays/ your replays and customsets/ your custom sets and tokens. If you moved your decks folder in desktop's settings, choose that folder instead.
source.pasteLead: Coming from Moxfield, Archidekt, MTG Arena or MTGO?

preview.unknown: {count, plural, one {# unknown card} other {# unknown cards}}
preview.destination: Put them in this folder (subfolders are kept)
preview.sameName: If a deck with the same name is already there
preview.replays: Import {count, plural, one {# replay} other {# replays}} into this browser
preview.customSets: Import {count, plural, one {# custom set file} other {# custom set files}} into this browser's card database
preview.cardDatabase: Not needed: {files}. Webatrice gets its card data from Scryfall.
preview.ignored: {count, plural, one {# line wasn't read} other {# lines weren't read}}

problem.tooLarge: Too large for the server (over 2 MB)
problem.pathTooLong: skipped, folder path too long for the server

failure.flood: The server is busy; try again in a minute
failure.folder: Not imported: couldn't create the folder {folder}

progress.keepOpen: Keep this window open until the import finishes. The server accepts a few decks per second, so large libraries take a few minutes.

summary.renamed: Decks whose names were already taken were imported with a number after the name.
summary.again: Run the import again to finish: decks that are already on the server are skipped.
